title: ComfyUI H3 context node surface
description: Everything a ComfyUI host can observe about this package's registered nodes, recorded so that a large adapter move can be proven not to change it. A host reads NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS, calls INPUT_TYPES() on each class, and reads a set of class attributes; that set, and not the module a class lives in, is the compatibility contract. What counts as observable is taken from the host's own node-info route rather than from intuition: it ships input_order built from INPUT_TYPES() key order, and reads INPUT_IS_LIST, OUTPUT_IS_LIST, OUTPUT_TOOLTIPS, DEPRECATED, EXPERIMENTAL, DEV_ONLY, API_NODE, SEARCH_ALIASES and ESSENTIALS_CATEGORY. Take this record before a move and after it: byte-equality is the proof. A record that differs means the move was wrong, never that the record should be updated.

nodes.description: One record per registered node, sorted by node_id so a diff is readable.

mapping_order.description: The order NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS declares, which is the order a host receives. Kept separately from the sorted records because both matter and they are not the same thing.

exported_names.description: Sorted contents of nodes.__all__. A name that leaves this list breaks an importer that a decomposition promised not to break.

float_value.description: A float option, recorded as its shortest round-tripping decimal. canonical_bytes refuses a raw float; repr is the shortest string that round-trips to the identical double, so this is the exact value rather than a rendering of it. The float key keeps it from being mistaken for an option that genuinely holds that string.

choices.description: Declaration order, not sorted: a reordered dropdown is a visible change.

sockets.description: Sorted by section and name so a diff is readable. The contract that ordering carries lives in input_order, not here.

input_order.description: Per section, the order INPUT_TYPES() declared its keys in. The host ships this verbatim and the frontend reconciles a saved workflow's positional widget values against it, so a reordering breaks old workflows.

input_is_list.description: INPUT_IS_LIST. Changes the host's calling convention: every input arrives as a list.

validates_inputs.description: VALIDATE_INPUTS exists. Never appears in node-info, but the host calls it when present.
